$comment: First-party models the price feed carries that the catalog leaves out on purpose, so the weekly coverage-gap check (scripts/watch-coverage-gaps.ts) stops naming them. Each entry is a regular expression over the feed's own keys and the reason. Add one only for a decision, never to quiet the issue: a model that should be captured belongs in data/models-allowlist.json instead.

items.reason: Vision variants. Not a comparable chat model; the same exclusion scripts/lib/allowlist.test.ts pins for glm-4.5v.
Free tiers, except glm-5.3-flash which is priced and captured. A free model has no cost to compare.
Superseded point releases, excluded in the meta-muse family on purpose.
OpenAI's Codex variants are agent-tool models sold for one product; not yet a decision to compare them as general chat.
Audio and realtime voice models, billed per audio token; a text cost calculator cannot price them.
Floating aliases that point at whichever Qwen tier is newest; the catalog tracks the versioned models instead.
